truth_evidence: Affected 2.1.0 to 2.5.3; fixed in 2.6.0 (session fixation: cookies from a redirect were ascribed to the target domain).
Fix commit 3bd8afb 'Don't ascribe cookies to the target domain', in tag v2.6.0 and not in v2.5.3. https://github.com/psf/requests/commit/3bd8afbff29e50b38f889b2f688785a669b9aafc
One line in resolve_redirects: extract_cookies_to_jar(prepared_request._cookies, prepared_request, resp.raw) becomes extract_cookies_to_jar(prepared_request._cookies, req, resp.raw).
Entry points: every request path reaches resolve_redirects.
